trigger: Pre-outcome causal review found that a 2021 Jan-Aug event could otherwise carry a barrier label resolved during the Sep-Dec fit holdout.

correction.rule: A training event is admissible only when both its entry timestamp and its first-touch label resolution timestamp are no later than the training cutoff.
correction.purged_overlap: Any event entered before the cutoff but resolved after it is excluded from model fitting and remains unavailable to training.
